description.zh: 勃艮第城堡（基础版）的流程定义——一局游戏从 Setup 到终局判胜的完整流程。与 concepts.json 配合：concepts.json 定义「有什么」（对象、行动、触发器、条件），本文档定义「按什么顺序进行」（Setup、阶段结构、回合结构、终局流程）。Setup 阶段使用 do_after 表达事件间的依赖关系：无 do_after 的事件互相独立，可任意顺序或并行执行；do_after 引用的事件必须先完成。每局 = 5 个阶段 × 5 轮 = 25 轮，每轮每位玩家一个回合（2 次骰子行动）。回合顺序不是座位顺序，而是石桥上的位置。
description.en: Flow definition for The Castles of Burgundy (base game) — the complete sequence of a game from setup to endgame adjudication. Complements concepts.json: concepts.json defines 'what exists' (objects, actions, triggers, conditions); this document defines 'in what order it happens' (setup, phase structure, turn structure, endgame). The setup phase uses do_after to express dependencies between events: events without do_after are independent and may execute in any order or in parallel; events listed in do_after must complete first. A game = 5 phases × 5 rounds = 25 rounds; each round gives every player one turn (2 die actions). Turn order follows the bridge, not seating.

description.zh: 整局勃艮第城堡游戏，作为最外层轮。包含设置、5 个阶段的循环（每阶段 5 轮）与终局。
description.en: The whole game of Castles of Burgundy as the outermost round: setup, the 5-phase loop (5 rounds each), and the endgame.

description.zh: 游戏设置：铺开<game_board>、按背面颜色分堆<hex_tile>、分配<goods>（5×5+17）、每名玩家拿 3 块货物、备好<silver>/<worker>、放<bonus_tile>、掷骰决定起始玩家、分发初始工人与起始<castle_tile>、堆叠石桥棋子。
description.en: Game setup: lay out the <game_board>, sort <hex_tile>s by back color, deal the <goods> (5×5+17), give each player 3 goods, prepare the <silver>/<worker> supplies, place <bonus_tile>s, roll for the starting player, deal starting workers and the starting <castle_tile>, and stack the bridge pieces.

description.zh: 把<game_board>按人数选择正确一面铺在桌中央（4 人用 4 人面，2-3 人用 2-3 人面）；<white_die>放版图旁。
description.en: Place the <game_board> in the center of the table on the correct side for the player count (4-player side, or the 2-3-player side); put the <white_die> next to it.

name.zh: 按背面颜色分堆六边形板块
name.en: Sort Hex Tiles By Back Color

description.zh: 把全部<hex_tile>从<game_box>取出，按背面颜色分成 7 堆（6 色 + 黑色）面朝下放入<hex_tile_pool>并各自洗匀。
description.en: Take all <hex_tile>s from the <game_box>, sort them face down into 7 piles by back color (6 colors + black) in the <hex_tile_pool>, and shuffle each pile.

description.zh: 把 42 块<goods>面朝下洗匀，分成 5 叠各 5 块，放入<game_board>的 5 个<phase_space>（A-E）。
description.en: Shuffle the 42 <goods> tiles face down, split them into 5 stacks of 5, and place one on each of the <game_board>'s 5 <phase_space>s (A-E).

quantity.zh: 每个阶段格 5 块，共 25 块。

description.zh: 分配阶段格后剩余的 17 块<goods>面朝下放入<goods_pool>。
description.en: The remaining 17 <goods> tiles after dealing the phase spaces go face down into the <goods_pool>.

description.zh: 每名玩家从<goods_pool>随机盲抽 3 块<goods>放入自己的<goods_storage>（同色叠放）。发完后剩余的货物放回盒中，本局不再使用。
description.en: Each player blindly draws 3 random <goods> tiles from the <goods_pool> into their <goods_storage> (same colors stacked). Whatever remains goes back in the box, unused this game.

description.zh: 把全部 24 <silver>从<game_box>取出放入<silver_supply>（版图旁）。
description.en: Take all 24 <silver> from the <game_box> into the <silver_supply> (next to the board).

description.zh: 把全部 26 <worker>从<game_box>取出放入<worker_supply>（版图旁）。
description.en: Take all 26 <worker>s from the <game_box> into the <worker_supply> (next to the board).

description.zh: 把 12 块<bonus_tile>从<game_box>取出，按颜色放到<game_board>的 6 个奖励板块格上（大板块叠在小板块上）。
description.en: Take the 12 <bonus_tile>s from the <game_box> and place them on the <game_board>'s 6 bonus spaces by color (large stacked on small).

description.zh: 所有玩家各掷 1 颗骰子，点数最高者成为起始玩家（平手重掷）。
description.en: All players roll one die each; the highest roller becomes the starting player (reroll ties).

rules.zh: 点数最高者成为起始玩家，将<ontology::starting_player>状态设为该玩家。
rules.en: Set <ontology::starting_player> to the player with the highest die roll.

description.zh: 把<white_die>交给起始玩家——白骰持有者即起始玩家。
description.en: Give the <white_die> to the starting player — the white die's holder is the starting player.

description.zh: 起始玩家得 1 个<worker>，其余玩家顺时针依次得 2/3/4 个——从<worker_supply>放入各自的<worker_space>。
description.en: The starting player takes 1 <worker>; the others take 2/3/4 clockwise in seating order — from the <worker_supply> into their <worker_space>s.

quantity.zh: 起始玩家 1 个，顺时针依次 2、3、4 个（按座位顺序）。
quantity.en: 1 for the starting player, then 2, 3, 4 clockwise by seating.

description.zh: 每名玩家把 1 块起始<castle_tile>从<game_box>放入自己<duchy>中央的深绿色 6 号空格上（第一块放置只需与它相邻）。
description.en: Each player places 1 starting <castle_tile> from the <game_box> onto the central dark-green 6 space of their <duchy> (your first placement only needs to touch it).

description.zh: 起始玩家的<playing_piece>放在<bridge>的 1 号格上，其余玩家的棋子按座位顺位依次叠在下面——此后每轮的行动顺序都按石桥位置（离市中心越近越先），与座位顺序无关。
description.en: The starting player's <playing_piece> goes on space 1 of the <bridge>, with the other players' pieces stacked below in seating order — from now on, each round's action order follows bridge position (closer to the city center acts first), not seating.

description.zh: 5 个阶段（A-E）的循环：每阶段开始做阶段准备（清理并补充仓库、摆放货物），然后打 5 轮，最后结算阶段结束收入。阶段数从 A 到 E，附带的区域完成附加分依次 10/8/6/4/2。
description.en: The loop of 5 phases (A-E): each phase starts with preparation (clearing and refilling depots, setting out goods), then plays 5 rounds, and finally settles phase-end income. Phases run A through E with area-completion bonuses of 10/8/6/4/2.

description.zh: 阶段开始准备：把版图上剩余的<hex_tile>移出游戏（A 阶段跳过），然后按背面颜色补满 6 个编号<depot>与<black_depot>并翻到正面，最后把当前<phase_space>的 5 块货物翻开放到<round_space>。
description.en: Phase-start preparation: remove leftover <hex_tile>s from the board (skipped in phase A), then refill the 6 numbered <depot>s and the <black_depot> by back color and turn them face up, and finally move the current <phase_space>'s 5 goods face up onto the <round_space>s.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 当前阶段是 A（第一个阶段）——A 阶段开始时不移除任何板块，直接从空版图补货。
<ontology::condition>.en: The current phase is A (the first) — no tiles are removed at the start of phase A; the empty board is filled directly.

description.zh: 从<hex_tile_pool>按背面颜色随机抽取<hex_tile>，翻到正面补满 6 个编号<depot>的板块格（4 人局各 4 格；2-3 人局按人数面更少）。
description.en: Randomly draw <hex_tile>s from the <hex_tile_pool> by back color and turn them face up to fill the 6 numbered <depot>s' tile spaces (4 each in a 4-player game; fewer on the 2-3-player side).

quantity.zh: 每个仓库补满板块格（4 人局各 4 块）。
quantity.en: Fill each depot's tile spaces (4 each with 4 players).

description.zh: 从<hex_tile_pool>黑色背面堆随机抽取<hex_tile>，翻到正面补满<black_depot>（4 人/3 人局 8 块，2 人局 4 块）。
description.en: Randomly draw black-backed <hex_tile>s from the <hex_tile_pool> and turn them face up to fill the <black_depot> (8 with 3-4 players, 4 with 2).

quantity.zh: 4 人/3 人局 8 块，2 人局 4 块。

description.zh: 把当前<phase_space>的 5 块<goods>翻开，逐个放到 5 个<round_space>上。
description.en: Turn the current <phase_space>'s 5 <goods> face up and place them one by one onto the 5 <round_space>s.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 当前阶段是 B-E——先移除版图上剩余的<hex_tile>，再补货。
<ontology::condition>.en: The current phase is B through E — leftover <hex_tile>s are removed first, then the board is refilled.

name.zh: 移除编号仓库剩余板块

description.zh: 把 6 个编号<depot>中剩余的<hex_tile>全部移入<game_box>——永久移出游戏，不回<hex_tile_pool>。即「阶段结束时剩余的瓷砖退回供应堆还是移出游戏？」的答案：**移出游戏、不退回**；船、矿、城堡等所有类型一视同仁。
description.en: Move all leftover <hex_tile>s in the 6 numbered <depot>s into the <game_box> — removed from the game for good, never back to the <hex_tile_pool>. This is the answer to 'are unused tiles returned to the supply at phase end?': **removed from the game, not returned**; ships, mines, castles — every type alike.

name.zh: 移除黑色仓库剩余板块

description.zh: 把<black_depot>中剩余的<hex_tile>全部移入<game_box>（永久移出游戏）。黑色背面的板块在阶段转换时同样被移出，与普通板块没有任何规则差异。
description.en: Move all leftover <hex_tile>s in the <black_depot> into the <game_box> (removed from the game for good). Black-backed tiles are removed at phase transitions just the same — no rule difference from regular tiles.

description.zh: 从<hex_tile_pool>按背面颜色随机抽取<hex_tile>，翻到正面补满 6 个编号<depot>的板块格（4 人局各 4 格；2-3 人局按人数面更少）。
description.en: Randomly draw <hex_tile>s from the <hex_tile_pool> by back color and turn them face up to fill the 6 numbered <depot>s' tile spaces (4 each in a 4-player game; fewer on the 2-3-player side).

quantity.zh: 每个仓库补满板块格（4 人局各 4 块）。
quantity.en: Fill each depot's tile spaces (4 each with 4 players).

description.zh: 从<hex_tile_pool>黑色背面堆随机抽取<hex_tile>，翻到正面补满<black_depot>（4 人/3 人局 8 块，2 人局 4 块）。
description.en: Randomly draw black-backed <hex_tile>s from the <hex_tile_pool> and turn them face up to fill the <black_depot> (8 with 3-4 players, 4 with 2).

quantity.zh: 4 人/3 人局 8 块，2 人局 4 块。

description.zh: 把当前<phase_space>的 5 块<goods>翻开，逐个放到 5 个<round_space>上（货物从不被移除——阶段开始时不清走仓库里的货物）。
description.en: Turn the current <phase_space>'s 5 <goods> face up and place them one by one onto the 5 <round_space>s (goods are never removed — depot goods are not cleared at phase start).

description.zh: 本阶段 5 轮的循环。每轮三步：①所有玩家同时掷自己的 2 颗<player_die>（起始玩家同时掷<white_die>）；②起始玩家把<round_space>最上面 1 块<goods>放到<white_die>点数对应的<depot>；③每位玩家按<bridge>位置依次各行动一个回合（每个回合 2 次骰子行动）。轮次格上的货物数即剩余轮数。
description.en: The loop of this phase's 5 rounds. Each round has three steps: ① all players roll their 2 <player_die>s simultaneously (the starting player also rolls the <white_die>); ② the starting player places the topmost <goods> from the <round_space>s onto the <depot> matching the <white_die>; ③ each player takes one turn in <bridge> order (each turn = 2 die actions). The goods remaining on the round spaces show the rounds left.

description.zh: 所有玩家同时掷自己的 2 颗<player_die>，点数公开；起始玩家同时掷<white_die>（白骰只能决定货物去向，不可用于行动、不可改）。
description.en: All players roll their 2 <player_die>s simultaneously; results are public. The starting player also rolls the <white_die> (its value only decides where goods go — never usable for actions, never modifiable).

description.zh: 起始玩家把<round_space>上**最上面**的 1 块<goods>放到<white_die>点数对应的编号<depot>（放在该仓库的货物格上，与已有货物叠放）。
description.en: The starting player places the **topmost** <goods> from the <round_space>s onto the numbered <depot> matching the <white_die> (on its goods space, stacking on any goods already there).

description.zh: 一轮玩家回合：每位玩家一个回合，**行动顺序按<bridge>位置**——越靠近市中心越先行动，同格叠堆最上面的先行动（与座位顺序无关）。
description.en: One cycle of player turns: one turn per player, in **<bridge> order** — closer to the city center acts first, and in a stack the top piece acts first (seating order is irrelevant).

description.zh: 一位玩家的回合：用 2 颗<player_die>执行 **2 次骰子行动**（每次行动用 1 颗骰子）——任意组合、任意顺序，可重复同一行动；行动前后随时可用<worker>改骰（每 1 个 ±1，1↔6 回绕）。此外每回合**至多 1 次**可额外花 2 <silver>从<black_depot>购买 1 块<hex_tile>（不占骰子），可在两次行动之前、之间或之后进行。
description.en: One player's turn: use your 2 <player_die>s to take **2 die actions** (one die per action) — any combination and order, repeating is allowed; you may spend <worker>s to adjust a die at any time before an action (±1 each, wrapping 1↔6). Additionally, **at most once per turn** you may pay 2 <silver> to buy 1 <hex_tile> from the <black_depot> (no die spent), before, between, or after your two actions.

description.zh: 用第 1 颗<player_die>执行一个合法行动。四种行动按各自条件过滤（如对应<depot>无板块时<take_hex_tile>不可选；<take_workers>永远可选）。
description.en: Use your 1st <player_die> for one legal action. The four actions are filtered by their own conditions (e.g. <take_hex_tile> is unavailable when the matching <depot> is empty; <take_workers> is always available).

description.zh: 用第 2 颗<player_die>执行一个合法行动——可以与第一次相同。
description.en: Use your 2nd <player_die> for one legal action — the same action may be repeated.

description.zh: 可选：本回合至多 1 次，花 2 <silver>从<black_depot>买 1 块<hex_tile>。本流程放在两次骰子行动之后，实际规则允许在行动之前、之间或之后进行。
description.en: Optional: at most once this turn, pay 2 <silver> to buy 1 <hex_tile> from the <black_depot>. Shown after the two die actions here, but the rules allow it before, between, or after them.

description.zh: 本阶段 5 轮打完后结算阶段结束收入：先按庄园中<mine_tile>数量发<silver>（<mine_income>），再结算<monastery_tile_2>的工人收入（<monastery_mine_worker_income>）。每位玩家各自结算。
description.en: After this phase's 5 rounds, settle phase-end income: first <silver> per <mine_tile> in each duchy (<mine_income>), then the <monastery_tile_2> worker income (<monastery_mine_worker_income>). Settled for each player.

description.zh: 每位玩家按<duchy>中<mine_tile>数量得<silver>。
description.en: Each player gains <silver> equal to their <mine_tile>s in the <duchy>.

description.zh: 结算<mine_income>：每个矿 1 <silver>。
description.en: Resolve <mine_income>: 1 <silver> per mine.

description.zh: 拥有<monastery_tile_2>的玩家按矿数额外得<worker>（先矿银币、后黄色效果）。
description.en: Players owning <monastery_tile_2> gain extra <worker>s per mine (silver first, then yellow-tile effects).

description.zh: 结算<monastery_mine_worker_income>：每个矿额外 1 <worker>。
description.en: Resolve <monastery_mine_worker_income>: 1 extra <worker> per mine.

description.zh: 终局阶段：E 阶段的 5 轮（共 25 轮）全部打完后进入——先结算<final_scoring>，再按<most_vp_wins>判定胜者。
description.en: Endgame phase: entered after all 5 rounds of phase E (25 rounds total) — first resolve <final_scoring>, then adjudicate the winner by <most_vp_wins>.

description.zh: 每位玩家结算<final_scoring>：未售<goods>、<silver>、<worker>换算<vp>，加上已放置的终局计分类<monastery_tile>。
description.en: Each player resolves <final_scoring>: unsold <goods>, <silver>, and <worker>s convert to <vp>, plus any placed final-scoring <monastery_tile>s.

description.zh: 结算<final_scoring>：未售货物每块 1 分、银币每枚 1 分、工人每 2 个 1 分、终局计分黄色瓷砖按各自规则。
description.en: Resolve <final_scoring>: 1 per unsold goods, 1 per silver, 1 per 2 workers, plus each final-scoring yellow tile's own rule.

by_card.rule: 只有放入庄园的知识瓷砖才计分，存储区里剩的不算。终局计分瓷砖：#15 每种已售货物 2 分；#16-23 庄园中每块对应建筑 4 分；#24 每种牲畜 4 分；#25 每块已售货物 1 分；#26 每块奖励板块 3 分。

score_table.note: 存储区剩余瓷砖不计分。

description.zh: 按<most_vp_wins>判定胜者：总<vp>最高者获胜；平局时先比庄园空位数（少者胜），再比石桥上位置（更靠后者胜）。
description.en: Adjudicate the winner by <most_vp_wins>: highest total <vp> wins; ties are broken first by fewest empty duchy spaces, then by furthest back on the bridge.

description.zh: 按顺序应用<most_vp_wins>的三条标准筛选胜者。
description.en: Apply <most_vp_wins>'s three criteria in order to select the winner.

rules.zh: 按<most_vp_wins>判定胜者：先比较总<vp>（<score_track>位置 + <vp_tile>），并列者比较<duchy>空位数（<fewest_empty_duchy_spaces>），仍并列者比较<bridge>位置（<farthest_behind_on_bridge>）。
rules.en: Adjudicate by <most_vp_wins>: compare total <vp> (position on the <score_track> plus the <vp_tile>), then <fewest_empty_duchy_spaces> among ties, then <farthest_behind_on_bridge>.
